principal_validity_threats: Independent single-symbol rather than shared-portfolio simulation

One partial-year OOS window with insufficient symbol-level sample sizes
required_evidence_before_scientifically_: A preregistered, scoped hypothesis with a controlled experimental design
Adequate symbol-level and time-period sample coverage
A shared-capital portfolio simulation with documented execution assumptions
Robustness to realistic transaction costs and slippage
Paper-trading evidence and, separately, live-execution validation
scope: Evidence synthesis only. No causal, universal, production-performance, or redesign recommendation is made.
